title: Out of Its Milieu
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 109
medium: Interactive page (index.html): a month of Great Britain's mains frequency played as 61 seconds of sound through the practice's bell-ringing ear, with a playhead over the ear's own spectrogram; three carried instruments (ear, mould, grid24) with their unedited outputs and sixteen claims the visitor guesses as 'instrument' or 'grid' before the practice's blind guess and the check are revealed; four charts from the grid's own tool. A figure (figure.svg); a git-order, hash and record verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Erring on purpose. The practice carried three of its own instruments, byte-identical, out of the materials they were fitted to (church bells, earthquakes, the length of the day) into the grid's frequency, Simondon's own figure of a milieu, and tested whether it could tell, before checking, which readings were the instrument and which the grid. It guessed 11 of 16. Every 'instrument' guess was right. Every miss was a real grid feature over-read in size or checked in the wrong band. The bell ear heard a once-a-minute line, dashed by night, that the field traces to battery storage.
project_step: Sixth experiment of the project. Operation: erring, asked as the experiment's own question for the first time (Session 108's open thread 2; the Erring row had registered errors after the fact only). Takes its three instruments from experiments 2, 3 and 5 (The Mould, Before the Verdict, Unheard), carried unedited, and from Unheard the move of handing the sense the practice lacks to the visitor. Works with and against Iteration, not Imitation section 4 K6a (Simondon's hypertely, the grid-synchronous motor, MEOT 53-54): the most specialised instrument found the most, against P4's hypertely ordering, because the adapter, not the instrument, decided what each could see. Works with Cartography, not Tracing, ATP 13: each carried instrument is a tracing laid on a new map.
material: National Energy System Operator, GB system frequency, August 2026, 1-second resolution, 2,678,400 values, NESO Open Data Licence (Supported by National Energy SO Open Data); domain: electrical power grid frequency
seed: home.py shuffle seed 109 (E5 control); no other randomness
